issue.title: Adopt the shared ledger-tools harness in footer and mark tests
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-4f.3 note #1 while splitting freshness tests. Evidence at bob-plugins b662018: scripts/ledger-tools-harness.cjs:9-73 and scripts/test-ledger-tools-freshness-footer.cjs:7-71 plus scripts/test-ledger-tools-freshness-mark.cjs:10-74 declare the same TestMarkdownView, TestPlugin, TestNotice and Obsidian/CodeMirror Module._load hook; D, CFG and sRow are duplicated too. Root cause is pre-existing per-file boilerplate from before the shared harness existed. Scope only these two compatible siblings: import shared stubs/plugin/helpers and equivalent fixtures from ledger-tools-harness.cjs, retaining suite-specific helpers and helper destructures. Preserve every test name, callback, option and assertion. Do not migrate freshness-mark-surfaces or other specialized stubs. Verify each file standalone, npm test, npm run build:check, npm run validate, <=1000-line hand-edited files, and run bob plugins sync from the opened linked checkout. Landing baseline: npm test 1809/1809, all six plugins validate, shared harness 345 lines. Duplicate searches and last-week task sweep found no equivalent task; active epics 28/3j are unrelated and 4f explicitly excludes this work. Small because identical loader boilerplate has a precise replacement and only two bounded files need edits.

task_type_fields.proposal: Replace the duplicated loader stubs and equivalent fixtures in test-ledger-tools-freshness-footer.cjs and test-ledger-tools-freshness-mark.cjs with imports from ledger-tools-harness.cjs while preserving specialized helpers and all test behavior.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The accepted bob-cli-4f plan explicitly excludes migrating sibling test files; their boilerplate predates this epic. This is a separate maintainability refactor with no remaining epic behavior or parity defect.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-4f.3 note #1 proposed migrating existing sibling freshness suites onto the new harness. Landing verified identical loader stubs still duplicated in both siblings; the accepted epic explicitly excludes sibling migration, so this focused tooling refactor belongs in a separate task.
